company.shortDescription: Clutch serves as a customer marketing platform for business-to-consumer brands.
company.description:
Clutch serves as a customer marketing platform for business-to-consumer brands. It provides traditional marketing CRM, loyalty, gift card, mobile, email, and direct mail solutions.

The company was created to help businesses succeed in an evolving marketing landscape. Since 2012, they have continued to grow their platform into an innovative, data-centric marketing solution with one focus that empowering brands with the best technology so that they can identify, understand and motivate their customers.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $46,172,147 to $134,156,861, a 2.91x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 55 (-18 over 90 days) and market heat at 26 (-34).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
